blocks.text: Banda chooses selected Singhs for the coming trial and the poet singles out Baghard Singh as a champion of unusual power and reputation.
Special missiles, blessings, and battlefield assignments are distributed so that the confrontation is prepared as both martial trial and demonstration of confidence.
Baghard Singh stands at the center of this page as the visible instrument through whom Banda’s challenge is to be answered.
